title: MLOps Engineer
description_html:
About the role

Example Systems hosts models for hospitals and clinics.

What you'll do

  • Run Kubernetes clusters that serve machine learning models
  • Build CI/CD for model releases
  • Own model monitoring and alerting

What you bring

  • Python
  • Docker and Kubernetes
  • Linux

Nice to have

  • MLflow
  • Azure

Pay and benefits

  • Salary: $115,000–$135,000 CAD per year
  • Four weeks of vacation and a yearly learning budget
